name: Rick Derringer
hook: A rock guitarist with his own hits who spent a decade producing comedy records for Weird Al Yankovic.
blurb: Derringer had early hits as a teenager with the McCoys ('Hang On Sloopy', 1965), played guitar on sessions and tours with Johnny and Edgar Winter, and had a solo hard rock hit with 'Rock and Roll, Hoochie Koo' (1973). From Yankovic's first album in 1983 until 1992, when Yankovic took over producing his own records, Derringer produced every Weird Al album. That seems an odd match for a decade of novelty parodies, but the job mostly called for exactly his skill: rebuilding other people's arrangements closely and convincingly, which is also what a working session guitarist does. He died in Ormond Beach, Florida, on 26 May 2025, aged 77.

signatureTracks.title: Rock and Roll, Hoochie Koo
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: His own best-known recording, and the hard rock credibility he brought to a decade of comedy production work.

signatureTracks.title: Eat It (produced for "Weird Al" Yankovic)
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: Derringer re-played the guitar solo from Michael Jackson's 'Beat It' himself for Yankovic's parody, a session guitarist's skill applied directly to the joke.
